crossRefs.note: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
“Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…
He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound…
Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is…

translations.web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
translations.bsb: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
translations.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
translations.asv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
